users.data: 125 weights (120 dated hourly from 2026-01-01T00:00Z, 5 with logged_at null, two of those with date null), 31 workout notes (30 short, one with saved_at set, 1 with 6000-character raw text) and 1 tombstoned note

users.label: b

gateMode: consent_required (health_sync_config), so the armed gate is exercised

cases.title: discovery metadata matches the Auth issuer; anonymous request gets a 401 challenge
SDK client: discovery, DCR, PKCE, explicit approval, initialize, tools/list, whoami
workout reads: own rows only, tombstone excluded, pagination, raw text opt-in and bounded
weight reads: pagination, unknown dates honest, unit reported as lb with original unavailable
empty cloud snapshot is reported as no_cloud_records with unknown coverage
real browser: direct link, sign-in, disclosure, Approve; the SDK client then reads only that user's data
two users, two SDK clients: each reads only its own rows
cross-user cursor and arguments cannot reach another user's rows
OAuth token has no direct table, writer, withdrawal or other-function access
anonymous, malformed, HS256, expired, wrong issuer/audience/client and first-party tokens are rejected
denied OAuth request (real browser) yields an error redirect and no code; the decided request id is recorded
user without cloud consent connects but data tools return consent_required and no rows
probe: Auth account endpoints reachable with an OAuth access token (production blocker PB-4 evidence)
refresh works: a new access token is issued and accepted
rotated-out refresh token replay is observed; disconnect kills every token chain
disconnect: unexpired access token and refresh token stop working; first-party session is unaffected
withdrawal blocks reads immediately (before purge); regrant needs the approved reconnect
deleted account: unexpired token stops working
gate lookup outage -> 503 and no data RPC runs; recovery restores service
consent lookup outage -> 503 and no data RPC runs, never an implicit allow
OAuth grant/session lookup outage -> 503 and no data RPC runs, never an implicit allow
data page RPC outage -> fixed internal tool error without database text
rate limiter outage fails closed (429), not open
slow database: the read ends with a timeout tool error at the database-call limit, long before the 10 s request deadline
request size, batch, malformed JSON and method limits
per-user limits: the data quota and HTTP limit stop one user and leave another unaffected
pre-auth limit: 120 requests per minute per client address, then 429
function logs hold none of the tokens, codes, cursors, authorization ids or user ids the run handled
